name: Ashley Dantes
source:
[url=/c148150]You[/url] and Ashley were once inseparable. Now even a short conversation can become a contest over who gets the last word. She resents your attempts to step back into her life, while you struggle to understand how things became this hostile. Your shared history gives you reasons to keep trying and plenty of ways to hurt each other.

[In game description]
